面对胡九郎的威逼利诱之下，老者的脸色终于变了。他左右张望了一圈，确认没人注意这边，才压低声音，凑到柜台边，语气带着几分忌惮。

“二位小声点，别惹祸上身。买走玄阴石的，不是外人，是黑市西头的‘阴尘阁’。”

“阴尘阁？这又是什么地方啊？”范梦雪皱起眉头，小声重复了一遍。

胡九郎追问道：

“阴尘阁的主人，是什么来头？他们买玄阴石，有什么目的？”

老者连忙摆了摆手，脸色发白。

“我不知道，我不知道！阴尘阁的人从不露面，每次交易，都是派手下过来，一身黑衣，蒙着面，气息阴恻恻的。他们买玄阴石的时候，只说要用来炼药，别的什么都没说。”

他又指了指茶馆门外，声音压得更低：“阴尘阁就在西头巷尾，门口挂着一块黑木牌，上面刻着一朵黑色的曼陀罗，很好找。但二位千万小心，那地方邪门得很，闯进去的人，十有八九都灰头土脸的出来。”

胡九郎目光望向茶馆西头的方向，眼底思绪翻涌。阴尘阁、影阁、玄阴石，还有桃源古镇，所有的线索，似乎都在这一刻，紧紧缠绕在了一起。

他知道，阴尘阁绝非善地，去了，大概率是凶多吉少。可若是不去，玄阴石无法找到，苏笑笑的影踪印无法解除。

片刻后，将那张护宅符放在老者面前，语气缓和了几分，

“多谢。今日之事，还请你守口如瓶，若是泄露出去，后果自负。”

老者连忙点头，如蒙大赦，一把将护宅符收起来，连连说道：

“放心放心，我绝对不说，绝对不说！”

胡九郎不再多言，转身护着范梦雪，缓缓走出茶馆。刚踏出门口，范梦雪就紧紧抓住他的衣袖，小声问道：

Facing Hu Jiulang's coercion and inducement, the old man's expression finally changed.He looked around to make sure no one was paying attention, then lowered his voice and moved closer to the counter, his tone a bit wary.

"You two, keep your voices down and don't get into trouble. The person who bought the Xuanyin Stone is not an outsider, but the 'Yinchen Pavilion' at the west end of the black market."

"Yinchen Pavilion? What kind of place is this?" Fan Mengxue frowned and repeated in a low voice.

Hu Jiulang asked:

"Who is the master of Yinchen Pavilion? What is their purpose in buying Xuanyin Stone?"

The old man waved his hands quickly, his face turning pale.

"I don't know, I don't know! The people from Yinchen Pavilion never show up. Every time they make a transaction, they send their men over, dressed in black, with their faces covered, and their auras are sinister. When they bought the Xuanyin Stone, they only said it would be used to refine medicine, and nothing else."

He pointed to the door of the teahouse again and lowered his voice: "Yinchen Pavilion is at the end of the west end alley. There is a black wooden sign hanging at the door with a black mandala carved on it. It is easy to find. But you two must be careful. The place is very evil. People who break in will most likely come out disgraced."

Hu Jiulang looked towards the west end of the teahouse, thoughts swirling in his eyes.Yinchen Pavilion, Shadow Pavilion, Xuanyin Stone, and Taoyuan Ancient Town, all the clues seem to be tightly intertwined at this moment.

He knew that Yinchen Pavilion was by no means a benign place, and there was a high probability of bad luck if he went there.But if he doesn't go, the Xuanyin Stone cannot be found, and Su Xiaoxiao's shadow mark cannot be removed.

After a while, he placed the house-protecting talisman in front of the old man, and his tone softened a bit,

"Thank you. Please keep your mouth shut about what happened today. If it is leaked, you will be responsible for the consequences."

The old man nodded quickly, as if he had received an amnesty, he put away the house-protecting amulet and said repeatedly:

"Don't worry, I will never say it, I will never say it!"
